section: A relationship to the O'Nan group
context: The [[catalog/finite-groups/sporadic/on|O'Nan group]] contains a maximal subgroup isomorphic to \(J_1\), of index \(2624832\). This gives an injective group homomorphism \(J_1\hookrightarrow\mathrm{O'N}\); its image is proper.

It belongs to the pariah display block of sporadic groups. The selected matrices represent \(J_3\) itself; the central cover denoted \(3.J_3\) is a different group. The [[catalog/finite-groups/sporadic/j1|first Janko group]] and [[catalog/finite-groups/sporadic/j4|fourth Janko group]] are separate catalogue objects.

The realization acts faithfully on \(\mathbb F_5^{111}\). Its matrix degree \(111\) is distinct from the order of the group. The defining data are the specified matrices; conditions on the orders of two unspecified generators do not replace those data. The notation \(\mathrm{Ly}\) names one finite group and has no rank or field parameter.
It belongs to the pariah display block of sporadic groups. The selected matrices represent the simple group itself; the central cover denoted \(3.\mathrm{O'N}\) is a different group.
It belongs to the pariah display block of sporadic groups. The selected matrices represent \(\mathrm{Ru}\) itself; the central cover denoted \(2.\mathrm{Ru}\) is a different group.
